mathematics.assertion_tested: On the completed zero-loss carrier-conserved field orbits, orbit-average forward and reverse gauge conversion widths, evolve a normalized two-state carrier fraction, and count emitted gauginos/direct photinos and energy. Compare momentum/orbit/time and rate-grid controls.

mathematics.conventions: The same conserved frozen FD momentum shape is assigned to each carrier species; original orbit is held fixed; no source quantum statistics, inverse scatterings or action feedback. External gaugino masses neglected only in emitted-energy boost. Energy ratio distinguishes origin-subtracted reference E from physical E after restoring the pinned T0 origin reference.
